summary: Client rejected D. Ruiz on system design; asks to check design depth.

changes.value: System design depth: explains trade-offs when designing a service
changes.quote: please check design depth before sending them.

study.prompt: The client asks for system design depth. What would you ask to see whether someone can explain design trade-offs, without running a technical interview yourself?
points: Asks for a system they designed from scratch
Asks which alternative they rejected and why
Listens for a trade-off, not a list of tools

coverage.quote: Tell me about the last production incident you owned.
How large is the Postgres database you worked with?
Do you use Kafka or another queue?

overweighted.quote: How many years have you worked with Go?

suggested.text: Ask for a system they designed, with one trade-off they chose
suggested.why: Client rejected on design depth; the screening did not ask.

suggested.text: Spend at most one question on Go
suggested.why: Go is trainable since the kickoff; 4 of 11 questions went to it.
